attackers_goals: Adversaries may use cloud-based email services to send phishing or spread malware, abusing legitimate email domains.
description: A cloud identity performed a sequence of activities which might indicate an intent to abuse the email service to send phishing or spam.
investigative_actions: Check if the identity intended to preform these actions or look for signs that the user account is compromised (e.g. abnormal logins, unusual activity).
name: Suspicious activity indicating a potential abuse of a cloud-native email service

variations.name: Suspicious activity indicating a potential abuse of a cloud-native email service involving discovery, weaponization, and impact
variations.description: A cloud identity performed a sequence of activities which might indicate an intent to abuse the email service to send phishing or spam. The behavior that was observed included discovery operations, attack preparation and actual email sending. These activities might indicate an intent to abuse the email service to send phishing or spam.
